about: Lever-hosted company job boards (jobs.lever.co/{company}): list and filter a company's open postings by location, team, work type and workplace type, and fetch posting details with apply links via Lever's public postings API.

commands.summary: List a company's open job postings on Lever, optionally filtered by location, team, department, commitment (work type) or workplace type; returns title, location, team, apply link.

params.name: company
params.description: Company slug as in jobs.lever.co/{company}, e.g. palantir, spotify. A 404 means the company doesn't use Lever.

params.name: location
params.description: Exact location label as shown on the board, e.g. 'New York, NY'. Take values from categories.location in unfiltered results.

params.name: team
params.description: Exact team label, e.g. 'Software Engineering'. Take values from categories.team.

params.name: commitment
params.description: Work type label, e.g. Full-time, Internship, Fixed-Term, Permanent (varies by company; see categories.commitment).

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max postings per page. (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of postings to skip (offset for paging).

commands.summary: Get full details of one Lever job posting (title, location, team, commitment, workplace type, plain-text description, hosted and apply URLs).

params.name: postingId
params.description: Posting UUID (the id field from list-postings).

commands.summary: Get a posting's schema.org JobPosting data from its public job page (hiring organization, location address, employment type, date posted, HTML description).

params.name: postingId
params.description: Posting UUID (the id field from list-postings).
